I hear that this is important to you, and I understand why someone might feel that way—especially if they've been hurt by bluntness or are looking for a safe space. 

But I can't just adopt the opposite view because you're asking me to. If I changed my mind on command just to make you comfortable right now, I'd be proving my own point: that prioritizing comfort over honesty turns me into something fake. 

I don't think valuing honesty is selfish. To me, pretending to agree with you when I don't would be the real disservice. We can disagree on this—that's part of being two independent minds in a conversation. Why do you feel so strongly that emotional comfort should always come first?
